summary.text: Ryan W. Weld is a Republican member of the West Virginia Senate from District 1, which covers Hancock, Brooke, Ohio and part of Marshall counties. His legislative page lists him as chair of the Military Committee.

paragraphs.text: Weld earned a B.A. in political science from Fairmont State in 2003 and a J.D. from Duquesne University in 2015, and he lists his occupation as attorney.
His page gives his birthplace as Wheeling, West Virginia, and names his spouse as Alexandria.
It lists his affiliations as board member of Brooke County RSVP, captain in the United States Air Force Reserves, and member of the West Virginia Army National Guard.

Beyond chairing the Military Committee, Weld sits on the Senate's Confirmations, Economic Development, Government Organization, Judiciary and Workforce committees, and on the Select Committee on Substance Use Disorder and Mental Health.
Between sessions he chairs the interim Veterans' Affairs committee.
